description: Recién graduados de secundaria y apasionados de las ciencias, la tecnología e ingeniería. Motivados a plantear soluciones a problemas que puedan generar un impacto positivo.
summary:
Space Frogg is an educational game where players join four frog astronauts on an adventure to the Moon. Throughout three chapters, players prepare for the mission, face problems during their journey, and explore the lunar surface by solving puzzles and challenges. The game is inspired by Artemis program and introduces players to what it takes to plan and complete a space mission.
Through the game, we want children to learn how different areas like science, engineering, technology, and communication work together during space missions. We also want to show that exploring space is not only about discovering new things beyond Earth, but also about finding knowledge and technology that can help us in our daily lives.
We believe every child should have the opportunity to learn about space and science. That's why we designed Space Frogg to be lightweight and playable on mobile devices, making it easier for more children to access this type of education, even if they don't have powerful computers. We hope our game encourages curiosity, creativity, and interest in STEM.
details:
General Project Overview

What if four frogs became astronauts and their next destination was the Moon? That's the idea behind Space Frogg, an educational adventure game that turns space exploration into an interactive experience. Players don't just read about a space mission; they become part of one, helping the frog crew prepare, face unexpected situations, and reach their destination.

Inspired by Artemis program, the game takes players through different stages of a lunar mission, introducing space-related concepts through its characters, story, puzzles, and challenges.

The Chapters

Chapter 1

Every great mission starts with a plan! Players meet Tongue and Baudinii at the space operations center, where they begin preparing for their journey to the Moon. They discover the mission's objectives, requirements, and the different systems involved in getting everything ready for launch.

Chapter 2

The mission is finally underway! Tongue and Baudinii reunite with Froggy and Frogatha as the four astronauts continue their journey through space. But things don't go exactly as planned. A meteor shower and an energy system failure put the crew in difficult situations, and players must solve puzzles and think of solutions to help them continue their journey safely.

Chapter 3

The Moon is finally within reach! After completing their journey, the four frogs arrive at the lunar surface, where a new stage of exploration begins. Players face new challenges and use what they have learned throughout the mission to help the crew accomplish its objectives.

Creative Approach

We wanted to make learning about space something children could enjoy instead of something that feels complicated or difficult to understand. That's why we chose frogs as our astronauts and created a story where players learn by participating in the mission.

The puzzles and challenges are connected to the situations the astronauts face, making the learning experience part of the adventure. We also wanted to show that a space mission is not the work of just one discipline. Science, engineering, technology, and communication all play important roles, and they need to work together to make these missions possible.

Development Considerations

From the beginning, we wanted Space Frogg to be accessible to more children. We considered that not everyone has access to a powerful computer, so we aimed to create a lightweight game that could also run on mobile devices.

We also focused on making the game easy to navigate, keeping the experience entertaining while introducing educational concepts through gameplay. Our intention was to create something that combines learning, creativity, and fun without making players feel like they are simply completing a school assignment.
